designationHistory.indexText: Interior Secretary Sally Jewell announced the Great Thicket National Wildlife Refuge, approving a plan to acquire up to 15,000 acres of young forest and shrubland in ten focus areas across six northeastern states for New England cottontail and other wildlife.

authority.citation: Secretarial approval of the refuge's land protection plan

designationHistory.note: DOI release dated October 25, 2016; the Monitor says the refuge was finalized 'on Tuesday', and October 25, 2016 was a Tuesday. The date of the first land interest acquired (formal establishment) was not found.

sources.name: U.S. Department of the Interior news release, Oct. 25, 2016, 'Secretary Jewell Announces Great Thicket National Wildlife Refuge'
Christian Science Monitor, 'Northeast United States will have new national wildlife refuge', Oct. 26, 2016
